entity: Tennessee Valley Authority, Director of Environmental Research and Development
summary: The Tennessee Valley Authority's Director of Environmental Research and Development reviewed the draft ORV environmental statement and expressed a favorable opinion, concluding that it adequately covered the pertinent considerations related to the proposed policies and guidelines concerning off-road vehicles. No substantive criticisms or suggestions were noted in the paraphrase of their comment.
